direction_notes: No neural activity measured; MMSE higher than placebo at 24 weeks (p<0.05) and ADAS-cog change 0.5 vs 5.0 at 52 weeks (p=0.237, not significant).
safety_notes: No serious clinical or radiographic adverse events; MRI (T2*, FLAIR, gadolinium-enhanced) showed no haemorrhage or BBB disruption; TCD velocities and labs unremarkable; all recorded AEs judged unrelated.

flags.reason: 9 patients randomised (6 TUS, 3 placebo); n_subjects is the 6 who received ultrasound. The total of 6 is stated only in the Fig. 4 legend and text (six TUS).
Paper says '2-ms burst lengths'; 20 % duty cycle at 100 Hz gives 2 ms, so burst is read as the pulse (resolved by arithmetic).
15 min/day delivered as three 5-min sessions with 5-min rests; 300 s is the length of one 5-min session (5 min x 60).
Transducers are described as unfocused / wearable LIPUS over the transtemporal windows; target is stated only as the temporal lobes.
Ispta given as 500 mW/cm2 (recorded as 0.5 W/cm2) without stating the domain.
Paper states the cohort was previously reported (volume changes) by Huang et al. 2025; possible reanalysis of an already-reported exposure.
